title: Navan Edge vs. ChatGPT for travel: Which is better for a work trip?
summary: An assistant that can suggest a hotel is useful. For a recurring work trip, you also want to know where you book, which preferences shape the options, and who you can contact for travel help.
body_markdown:
An assistant that can suggest a hotel is useful. For a recurring work trip, you also want to know where you book, which preferences shape the options, and who you can contact for travel help. Those details determine how much of the trip you still need to organize yourself.


ChatGPT is a general assistant that can search the web for travel information.\[1\] Its Expedia app can show flight and hotel options, then send you to Expedia to book.\[2\] Navan Edge is a personal AI travel agent for frequent business travelers who arrange their own work trips.\[6\] We'll compare how ChatGPT and Navan Edge handle booking, travel preferences, loyalty rewards, and support so you can decide which works better for your trips.


### Key takeaways


- ChatGPT can help you research and compare travel options, with booking capabilities that vary depending on the connected service, your account, and where you're located.
- Navan Edge brings flight, hotel, and restaurant booking into one conversation, applying your travel preferences and loyalty information while providing 24/7 travel support throughout your trip.\[6\]
- For travelers who regularly arrange their own work trips, the decision comes down to booking convenience, how much loyalty rewards matter, and the support available when plans change.


## What’s the verdict on Navan Edge vs. ChatGPT for travel?


For frequent business travelers who want to plan, book, and manage trips in one place, Navan Edge may be the better fit. It supports flight, hotel, and restaurant reservations in chat, with 24/7 travel support and access to human experts whenever additional assistance is needed.\[6\]


ChatGPT makes sense if you want one assistant for many tasks, including trip research. Its connected travel apps can add current shopping results; Expedia’s app, for example, shows flight and hotel prices and availability before sending you to Expedia to book.\[2\]


The deciding factor is what you need beyond trip research. ChatGPT offers flexibility across a range of tasks, while Navan Edge brings booking, personalized recommendations, loyalty benefits, and ongoing travel assistance into one experience.\[6\]

OpenAI Support handles ChatGPT product issues.\[5\] For travel reservations, assistance and changes depend on the booking provider.\[1\]\[2\]


## What does each tool look like in a work-trip scenario?


Imagine you have a client meeting in San Francisco at 9 a.m. Wednesday. You need to arrive Tuesday, prefer a nonstop flight and a quiet hotel near the client's office, and want to book dinner for three, including one vegetarian guest.


With ChatGPT, you can research travel options and, where available, compare flight and hotel prices through the Expedia app. You can then continue to Expedia to book.\[1\]\[2\] ChatGPT Work can also interact with supported booking websites, although some steps may require your input.\[3\] Restaurant booking depends on the available provider and account features.\[1\]


With Navan Edge, you can describe the trip in one conversation, review personalized flight, hotel, and restaurant options, and confirm your bookings in chat. Your preferences and connected loyalty programs help shape the recommendations.\[6\]


If your flight is delayed, you can continue that same conversation with Navan Edge to get help with your plans. The assistant provides ongoing travel support, and a human travel expert can join the chat when you need additional assistance, with your trip details already available.\[6\]


## Which assistant works better for frequent business travel?


If you take the same route several times a year, you probably have preferences that do not change with every meeting: an aisle seat, a hotel with a gym, or a brand whose loyalty program you use. Remembering those details helps only if they shape the next set of travel options.


Navan Edge brings together preferences shared in chat, booking history, and connected loyalty programs. It can distinguish a request for the current trip from a preference that should influence future recommendations.\[6\] That matters when the client’s office changes but you still want the kind of hotel you usually choose.


ChatGPT can also remember preferences when Memory is enabled. It can use relevant details from past conversations and other available sources, although it doesn't retain every detail. Memory features and controls vary by plan, region, platform, and workspace settings.\[7\]


For occasional trips to new destinations, ChatGPT's research and personalization features may be enough. If you frequently travel the same routes or return to familiar hotels, a[dedicated AI assistant for business travel](https://navan.com/blog/edge/how-to-use-ai-for-business-travel) can make repeat bookings easier by remembering your preferences and applying them to future trips.\[6\]


## How do the apps handle travel loyalty and rewards?


The hotel that earns the most useful rewards may not be the cheapest room, and the flight on your preferred airline may not be the shortest. Understanding what you'll earn can help you decide whether those tradeoffs are worthwhile.


Navan Edge's Loyalty Wallet brings supported airline and hotel programs together so you can manage your points, miles, and status in one place. It also uses your connected programs to personalize recommendations and highlight potential earnings, making it easier to choose bookings that support your loyalty goals.\[6\]


With Navan Edge, you can also earn rewards in multiple ways:


- Loyalty points or miles on qualifying bookings
- Rewards or multipliers from an eligible credit card
- Up to 10% back in Amazon Gift Cards on eligible hotel stays booked through Navan Edge.


For example, suppose you're choosing between a lower-priced hotel and one where you're close to reaching the next loyalty tier. You might prefer the second option if the stay qualifies for the points or benefits you're working toward. Compare the rate, location, and rewards eligibility before deciding.


ChatGPT can help you research loyalty programs and compare options. With Expedia's app, you can review flights and hotels before completing the purchase on Expedia.\[2\] Check the selected rate's earning conditions with the booking provider, especially if maintaining status matters to you


## What support is available on both ChatGPT and Navan Edge?


If your plans change, the important question is how you can get help with your reservations.


With ChatGPT, support depends on where you completed the booking. OpenAI Support handles issues with ChatGPT itself, while Expedia or the relevant travel provider handles flight and hotel reservation questions.\[2\]\[5\] For restaurant bookings made through ChatGPT, changes and cancellations go through the confirmation email or reservation provider.\[1\]


Navan Edge provides 24/7 travel support in the same conversation where you planned and booked your trip. You can ask the AI assistant for help with changes or disruptions, and a[travel expert](https://navan.com/blog/edge/travel-concierge) can join when you need additional assistance or a request requires special handling.\[6\]


Because the conversation and trip details are already available, you don't have to start over explaining your situation when a human joins. That can be especially useful for unusual hotel requests, flight disruptions, or other changes that need extra attention.\[6\]


## Should you choose Navan Edge or ChatGPT for travel?


ChatGPT is a good fit if you want a general-purpose assistant to research destinations, compare travel options, and help with other tasks. Connected travel services can also help with booking, depending on what's available to you.


Navan Edge may be better suited to frequent business travelers who want to plan, book, and manage trips in one conversation. It combines personalized recommendations, loyalty benefits, and 24/7 travel support, with human expertise available when needed.


If you regularly arrange your own work trips, consider how much time you spend managing bookings, tracking rewards, and handling changes. Those are the areas where a dedicated travel assistant can make the biggest difference.
